implementation: Complete owned and borrowed unweighted OLS samples use Repeated Retained with zero heap storage.
Classified builders keep their original mutable reserved vectors and wrap them as Explicit only after classification.
Logical reference access and exact sequence equality do not materialize storage; empty sequences compare independently of the repeated scalar.
No-drop compaction retains the owner; actual deletion materializes fallibly after replacement reservations and before mutation. Explicit storage transfers its pointer/capacity.
Raw repeated values are not receipts: shape/count/value/weight and row/drop consistency checks remain authoritative.
costs: Complete OLS samples remove an N-byte mask on this host. Eliminated allocations no longer have allocation-failure points.
Actual deletion still requires an N-byte original-axis mask under the unchanged worst-case compaction forecast. Classified and PPML mutable ledgers retain actual capacities.
No wall-time gain is claimed before the whole-H Mac boundary.

review.review_type: independent high-effort static architecture and memory-admission review
scope: UniformValues repeated/explicit storage, logical equality/reference access, consuming fallible materialization and actual-capacity accounting
Authoritative raw sample validation and complete-sample shortcut proof continuity
Actual-deletion versus no-drop compaction ownership, allocation and mutation order
OLS and PPML preparation/generation/rebase forecast coverage
PPML explicit mutable ledgers and read-only generation samples

conclusions: Repeated Retained storage owns no heap buffer; public representation construction does not establish sample validity.
Raw mask length is checked before shortcut or indexing. Non-Retained repeated masks decline the complete shortcut and retain the existing numeric/weight/count/row-drop validation order.

No-drop compaction returns before materialization. Actual deletion reserves replacement row/value/weight/adjustment banks, then materializes the full original-axis reason bank fallibly before mutation.

Explicit materialization moves the existing Vec without copying or changing its capacity; there is no old-plus-new reason-bank overlap. Repeated materialization replaces an allocation-free scalar owner.

OLS singleton_compaction_arrays remains N*(16*value_columns+18), retaining two value banks, two row maps, one N-byte original reason bank and one N-byte keep mask. The new 50N/49N witness protects this allowance for two numeric columns.
PPML route_generation retains original_n reason allowance; route_rebase retains replacement_drop_reason_bytes; existing preparation/current-plus-replacement staging is unchanged.

Production PPML from_selection already receives explicit Vec drop reasons, stores an explicit initial ledger, and final_drop_reasons copies that explicit ledger. The new prepared_model::new into_vec conversion is cfg(test), not a production materialization path.
Read-only generation samples may use Repeated storage. No allocating indexing, implicit slice conversion, candidate-marker change, arithmetic or model-policy change found.
The sealed PreparedOlsData owner and existing OLS publication shape/finiteness/receipt barriers remain intact.
